title: The Academy’s Strongest Mob Healer ~ I Reincarnated as a Mob in a Death Game World, Got the Terrible Draw of “Healer” As My Job, and Became the Strongest Using My Knowledge of the Game
description:
A famous game romance action RPG "Dungeon Academia".
In that famous world of "game to the death," I reincarnated as a mob with the worst job possible: "Healer. "
My fate was dying right away... However... I'll use my knowledge from grinding this game for days on end in my previous life to overturn that fate. 
A reincarnation fantasy, where healing is turned into a weapon to fashion a meteoric rise to the strongest in the world.
author: Yamata Nagato
